text.jp:
この“方尖塔の間”は、吾が
長い時間をかけて用意した特別な部屋……
text.official_en:
This Obelisk Chamber is a special room that I spent
a long time preparing.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
浮世の時間との繋がりさえも切り離され、
部屋そのものが一種の結界として機能しておる。
text.official_en:
'Tis cut off from the flow of time in the world of the
living. The room itself functions as a sort of barrier.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
故に、外からは誰もこの場所に
辿り着くことは出来ぬ。――吾以外はな。
text.official_en: And so none but I can reach it from the outside.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
したがって、ダグシオンの中とは言え、
ここにおる限りは安全というわけじゃ。
text.official_en:
That is why, even within Dagsion, we are safe so
long as we are here.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
すでに死者となっておる者たちを生きたまま
この現代に連れてくる、ということは――
text.official_en:
To bring those who have already died forward into
this future is a bit tricky.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
因果律を歪め、本来辿っていた結末を
微妙に変えてしまうということじゃ。
text.official_en:
It involves bending the law of cause and effect,
subtly changing the original conclusion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
当然、個々に干渉していく都合上、
それぞれで起こる細かな事象には差が生まれる。
text.official_en:
Because of our particular interferences, the resulting
events each time are a bit different.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
さりとて、複数の平行世界が
生まれるというわけではないのじゃ。
text.official_en:
But 'tis not a case of diverging roads. All the futures
we shape lead here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どちらかというと……複数の因果律の合成が
行われる事になる。要するに――
text.official_en:
If I had to explain... 'Tis like multiple laws of cause
and effect combined into a composite.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
確定した複数の過去が同時に重ね合わさった
ような状態になる……とでも言おうか。
text.official_en:
The many established pasts are layered on top of
one another, but all are part of the same whole.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一番想像しやすい不具合は、各人の記憶も
重なり合って混乱が生まれる事じゃろうな。
text.official_en:
'Tis conceivable that these contradictory memories
may give rise to some confusion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ある者にとり、死んだ筈の者が生きておったり、
あった筈の物が無くなっておったり……
text.official_en:
A person may meet someone they remembered to be
dead, carrying an object that was never created.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが、なにしろ世界がこのような非常時なのでな。
その程度のことは皆に我慢してもらわねばな。
text.official_en:
But these small eddies in the flow of time are far
preferable to the current state of the world.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ、因果の仕組みについて、
いろいろと疑問はあるかとは思うが……
text.official_en:
I'm sure you have questions regarding the
mechanisms of causality.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おぬしがこの方尖塔の先で目にする事の全ては
この世界の事実となる、ということじゃ。
text.official_en:
But they can all be answered by saying that what you
witness beyond these obelisks is considered truth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
じゃが、各人の因果律に吾らが
干渉できる局面というものは限られておる。
text.official_en:
Just know that our windows of interference with
each person's causality are limited.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それ故、ここぞという所を狙って
因果律に働きかける必要があるのじゃが、
text.official_en:
We must carefully choose our moments to tip the
scales in our favor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……まあ、その点に関しては
吾にすべてまかせておけば良い。
text.official_en: And when I say "we," I mean "I."

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今のダグシオンの中に
このような部屋があるとは思わなかった。
text.official_en:
I didn't think there was room in blighted Dagsion for
a chamber like this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ここは不思議な空間だな……
清浄で……静かで……
text.official_en: A strange space. It's so pure...and quiet.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まるで……そう、この場所の時間そのものが、
世界から隔絶されているかのような……
text.official_en: As if time in here is separate from the world outside.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……本当に、私達があのバロールに
対抗することなどできるのだろうか……
text.official_en: Can we really mount an opposition to Balor?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
すまない。私としたことが
少し、弱気になってしまっていたようだ。
text.official_en: Sorry. I nearly lost my nerve for a moment there.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
すでにジョカはその機能を
完全に停止してしまっているだろうな……
text.official_en:
No doubt Nuwa has stopped functioning entirely
by now.
text.real_en:
No doubt Joka has stopped functioning entirely
by now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私も、里に残っている記録に目を通したり、
ゼノン様から伝え聞いただけなのだが。
text.official_en:
I've only read what remains in the village records
and heard a bit more from Master Zenon, but...
text.real_en: I've only read the records still kept in the village and heard about it from Zenon-sama, but...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの船の名は、遠い昔の伝承にある
創世神話の蛇が由来になっているんだそうだ。
text.official_en:
apparently that ship's name comes from the snake in
an ancient, long-forgotten creation myth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
かつての世界では、ジョカのような
規模の船が何隻も存在していたらしいが。
text.official_en:
The old world had a number of ships the size of
Nuwa, or so they say.
text.real_en:
The old world had a number of ships the size of
Joka, or so they say.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
想像しただけでも
圧倒されそうになるな……本当に。
text.official_en: The thought of it boggles the mind...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
フォトナが言っていたことが
本当だとしたら、つまり――
text.official_en: I've been thinking about what Fortuna said.
text.real_en: I've been thinking about what Fotona said.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最終的に、複数の観測結果が同時に
重ね合わさったような状態になるってことか。
text.official_en:
If she's right, multiple observed results will be fused
together, one on top of the next.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そいつはまるで、因果律と不確定原理が
相反しているような状態……とでもいおうか。
text.official_en:
It's hard to reconcile the law of causality here with
the uncertainty principle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……正直言って、もう私なんかの
理解の追いつかない世界だよ。
text.official_en:
But who knows? This is far from the world I thought
I knew all those years ago. I can't keep up anymore.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あんたに自分の心核を与えるなんて
ゼノンも無茶をしたもんさ。前代未聞だよ。
text.official_en:
It was a desperate measure for Zenon to give you his
own Heart Core. Such a thing is almost unheard of.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
文字通りあんたにすべてを託したんだね。
その期待に、応えてやらなきゃいけないね。
text.official_en:
He gave you everything he could, in a very literal
sense. Make sure his final gift isn't wasted.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こいつは、人間の世界を
バロールから取り戻すための戦いなんだ。
text.official_en:
This will be humanity's world, or it will be Balor's,
and which it is will fall to you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえば培養槽――人工子宮ともいうが。
あれの居心地はどうだった？
text.official_en:
By the way...the culture vat, or incubation tank...
how did you find it? Was it comfortable?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なに、身体より先に意識が宿ってると
退屈で仕方なかったんじゃないかと思ってね。
text.official_en:
It just occurred to me how boring it must have been
if you were conscious before your body was finished.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
実は私もあの水槽で製造されたのさ。
……もう随分と昔の話になるけどね。
text.official_en:
I was made in a tank like yours too, you know.
Though that was a long time ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だから、私をただの年寄りと思うんじゃないよ。
歳はくってても、この身体だって特別製さ。
text.official_en:
So don't go thinking I'm some random elder. I may
be getting on in years, but this body is custom-built.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ジョカもいい歳だったからね。
難産だったろうが、満足してるだろうさ。
text.official_en:
Nuwa was getting old too... Yours must have been
a difficult birth, but I'm sure she's proud.
text.real_en:
Joka was getting old too... Yours must have been
a difficult birth, but I'm sure she's proud.
